content:
This week Apple refreshed its third-party accessories lineup with eight new products, including the Aqara Thermostat Hub W200.

Aqara debuted the Thermostat Hub W200 at CES 2026 in January before officially launching it in April.

The Aqara Thermostat Hub W200 costs $169.95 at Apple. While that's $10 more than Amazon, if you have Apple credit to use or are already planning to shop at Apple, it might be more convenient to buy there.

Apple adding it to both its online store and its retail stores is a strong endorsement. Notably, it supports Apple Home-exclusive features such as Apple Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance.

Apple also sells the pricier ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium, which supports built-in Siri and HomeKit—rather than Matter-based HomeKit.

Still, the Aqara option is compelling because it supports Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance through the Apple Home app.

This week's Apple Store additions also include another Aqara smart home product: the Aqara Climate Sensor W100.

Beyond those two Aqara smart home products, Apple now also sells these six other accessories:

  • Nimble Powerstack Charger/Power Bank System
  • Herschel Cloudform 14-inch MacBook Sleeve
  • Herschel Cloudform 16-inch MacBook Sleeve
  • Herschel Cloudform MacBook XL Backpack
  • CalDigit Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) Pro Cable (2.0 m)
  • Logitech Spotlight 2 Presentation Remote

Coming up, there's the iPhone Duo launching at the end of this month, and the rumored screen-equipped HomePod expected in October.
